OntologyKindMapping.description: Mapping from a language's native AST `language_kind` to ASP's General Ontology `kind`.

description.description: Concise semantic description inherited from Scheme's `defasp-language`.

ProviderCapabilities.description: Minimal capability flags published by a native language provider.

astInspect.description: Provider implements `ast-inspect` returning authoritative UTF-8 byte spans.

astVerify.description: Provider implements `ast-verify` batched compiler soundness oracle.

openEdb.description: Provider emits Open EDB facts directly or via `ast-inspect`.

ProviderProjectSurface.description: Unified project entrypoint, root marker, and configuration surface owned by a provider.

workspaceFiles.description: Workspace or lockfile manifests anchoring multi-package resolution.

ProviderSpecialExtension.description:
Language-owned special protocol extension layered onto ASP's universal protocol.

Each provider under `languages/asp-*` declares its own native `kindMappings`,
`:gerbil-ascent` `specialRelations`, and optional Draft 2020-12 JSON Schema
fragment (`schema`) describing language-specific query facets & enum domains.
ASP merges and forwards these over HTTP/gRPC so Marlin projects dynamic
completions and relations with zero language hardcoding.

kindMappings.description: Native compiler `languageKind` -> ASP General Ontology `kind` mappings.

schema.description:
Provider-owned Draft 2020-12 JSON Schema object declaring language-specific
query properties, attributes, and enum values merged into `targetedSchema`.

specialRelations.description: Language-specific `:gerbil-ascent` relation names owned by this provider.

ProviderSyntaxSurface.description:
Provider-reported native lexical syntax surface (owned by the language provider,
never duplicated in Scheme ontology definitions).

blockComment.description: Block comment `[open, close]` pair reported by the native parser (e.g. `["/*", "*/"]`, `["#|", "|#"]`, `["#=", "=#"]`).

delimiterPairs.description: Balanced delimiter `[open, close]` pairs native to this language.

lineComment.description: Line comment opener reported by the native parser (e.g. `//`, `#`, `;`).

statementTerminator.description: Optional statement terminator token (e.g. `;` for Rust/TypeScript, absent for Python/Julia/Scheme).

ProviderTransport.description: Minimal HTTP-JSON / gRPC transport descriptor for a provider server.

command.description: Subcommand arguments launching the resident provider server (e.g. `["serve"]`).

extensions.description: Lowercase leading-dot source extensions owned by this provider (e.g. `[".rs"]`).

languageId.description: Canonical language identifier served by this provider.

project.description: Unified project root markers, entrypoint files, workspace manifests, and config files.

projectMarkers.description: Legacy flat project root marker files (e.g. `["Cargo.toml"]`); prefer unified `project.markers`.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version carried inside the document payload (not in the filename).

special.description: Optional language-owned special protocol extension (native kinds, relations, JSON Schema facets).

syntaxSurface.description: Native lexical syntax surface reported by the provider itself.

transport.description: Resident HTTP-JSON / gRPC server launch and route descriptor.
